name: Feature post (five-line, GM house style)
ladder: why it happens (a process, not a villain)
the ask: relatable line + Download gm.markets to start trading

ingredients.figure_model: gpt-image-2 via pipeline/gen_figures.py — locked robed-statue STYLE, transparent, alpha-trimmed; one statue on every content slide; library reuse allowed when quota is gone
layout_rules: no cards — the background is the container
big-number slides: number left, statue right
text never touches the figure (per-line collision after font + image load)
copy_rules: punch at friction, never at a party

parameters.name: feature
parameters.plain: the one product feature this post is about

parameters.name: five_lines
parameters.plain: friction, why, not your fault, what changes, the ask

parameters.name: chips
parameters.plain: four short labels above the headlines

parameters.name: diagram
parameters.plain: which block explains it: receipt, journey, bignum or table

parameters.name: figure_subjects
parameters.plain: one robed statue subject per content slide

gates: CTA maps one-to-one to the argument
feature exists in the product's own Terms, else HOLD
publish check: swipe order, music at compose time, native schedule

cost_per_run.figures: 4 x gpt-image-2 (~5.5k image tokens each), or 0 with library reuse
